title:
Demons & Evil
or Unclean Spirits
description:
Demon / Demonise / Demonised
Noun: Daimonion and Daimon - Demon also referred to as an unclean or evil spirit.
Verb: Daimonizomai - to demonise (possess is not appropriate for believers)
Adjective: Daimoniodes - to be demonised (not possessed) Demons are an external force that affects someone or thing.
